name: Seoul National University
summary: Seoul university with an international undergraduate track; degrees are Korean-taught (TOPIK level 3 route) and English courses vary by department.

handoff.label: Undergraduate admissions guide for international students

ib.text: IB predicted or final scores may be uploaded with the application. Language proof is TOPIK level 3 or TOEFL iBT 80 / IELTS 6.0; ask the department which of its courses run in English.

notes: The guide tells applicants to ask the department or college whether English-taught courses exist in the major they want; no list of English-taught degrees is published.
Korean proficiency (TOPIK level 3, or level 4 completed at a Korean university language centre) is one accepted proof of language; an English test is the other.
The guide online now is for Spring 2027 entry (applications 6 to 9 July 2026); the page says international admission runs for both spring and fall semesters.
